dimension.name: triage-rail
dimension.description: A session rail for threads, not folders: a violet Needs-you strip (oldest wait first), Now / Today / Yesterday / This week / Earlier groups, unread rows emphasised, and one Sweep that archives idle sessions older than a week. Built from @fraym/ui primitives and the rail slot's specVersion 2 channels only - no shipped rail inside.
